quote: Isis is an ancient Egyptian goddess who became the most popular and enduring of all the Egyptian deities.

statement.id: Isis adalah dewi Mesir kuno.
statement.en: Isis is an ancient Egyptian goddess.

quote: Isis’ name is first attested in the fifth dynasty in the Pyramid texts.

statement.id: Nama Isis pertama kali tercatat dalam Teks Piramida dari dinasti kelima.
statement.en: Isis's name is first attested in the Fifth Dynasty Pyramid Texts.

quote: She was the wife of Osiris and the mother of Horus, and thus was symbolically mother to the pharaoh.

statement.id: Isis adalah istri Osiris dan ibu Horus.
statement.en: Isis is the wife of Osiris and mother of Horus.

quote: According to this myth Isis was able to revive Osiris after he had been killed by his brother Seth and she became pregnant with their son Horus.

statement.id: Menurut mitos, Isis menghidupkan kembali Osiris setelah dibunuh Seth.
statement.en: According to the myth, Isis revived Osiris after Seth killed him.

quote: After Horus’ birth, Isis nurtured her child and protected him from Seth and other dangers.

statement.id: Isis membesarkan Horus dan melindunginya dari Seth.
statement.en: Isis nurtured Horus and protected him from Seth.

quote: This statuette shows the goddess in her most beloved pose, nursing her son Horus (known also as the lactans pose).

statement.id: Sebuah patung kecil menunjukkan Isis menyusui putranya Horus.
statement.en: A statuette shows Isis nursing Horus.

quote: Her cult began in the Nile Delta and her most important sanctuary was there at the shrine of Behbeit El-Hagar, but worship of Isis eventually spread to all parts of Egypt.

statement.id: Kultus Isis bermula di Delta Nil dan akhirnya menyebar ke seluruh Mesir.
statement.en: Isis's cult began in the Nile Delta and spread throughout Egypt.

quote: The abundance of statuettes in this particular pose demonstrate some of the qualities for which Isis was most valued in the first millennium BC: her role as a life-giver and protector.

statement.id: Patung-patung Isis bersama Horus menonjolkan perannya sebagai pemberi kehidupan dan pelindung.
statement.en: Statuettes of Isis and Horus emphasize her role as life-giver and protector.

quote: Her name comes from the Egyptian Eset, ("the seat") which referred to her stability and also the throne of Egypt as she was considered the mother of every pharaoh through the king's association with Horus, Isis' son.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, namanya berasal dari kata Mesir Eset ("tempat duduk"), yang merujuk pada kestabilannya dan juga takhta Mesir, karena ia dianggap ibu setiap firaun lewat kaitan raja dengan Horus, putranya.
statement.en: According to World History Encyclopedia, her name comes from the Egyptian Eset ("the seat"), referring to her stability and also the throne of Egypt, as she was considered the mother of every pharaoh through the king's association with Horus, her son.

quote: Her symbols are the scorpion (who kept her safe when she was in hiding), the kite (a kind of falcon whose shape she assumed in bringing her husband back to life), the empty throne, and the sistrum.

statement.id: Lambang Isis adalah kalajengking (yang menjaganya saat bersembunyi), kite (sejenis elang yang wujudnya ia ambil untuk menghidupkan suaminya), takhta kosong, dan sistrum.
statement.en: Isis's symbols are the scorpion (who kept her safe in hiding), the kite (a kind of falcon whose shape she assumed in bringing her husband back to life), the empty throne, and the sistrum.

quote: She was also known as Weret-Kekau ("the Great Magic") for her power and Mut-Netjer, "Mother of the Gods" but was known by many names depending on which role she was fulfilling at the moment.

statement.id: Isis juga dikenal sebagai Weret-Kekau ("Sihir Agung") karena kekuatannya dan Mut-Netjer, "Ibu Para Dewa", serta punya banyak nama menurut peran yang sedang dijalankannya.
statement.en: Isis was also known as Weret-Kekau ("the Great Magic") for her power and Mut-Netjer, "Mother of the Gods", and had many names depending on the role she was fulfilling.

quote: In time, she became so popular that all gods were considered mere aspects of Isis and she was the only Egyptian deity worshiped by everyone in the country.

statement.id: Lama-kelamaan Isis begitu populer sehingga semua dewa dianggap sekadar aspek Isis dan ia satu-satunya dewa Mesir yang dipuja semua orang di negeri itu.
statement.en: In time Isis became so popular that all gods were considered mere aspects of her and she was the only Egyptian deity worshiped by everyone in the country.

quote: Like the Eleusinian Mysteries, the Cult of Isis grew into a Mystery Religion promising the secrets of life and death to initiates, who were then sworn to secrecy.

statement.id: Seperti Misteri Eleusis, kultus Isis tumbuh menjadi agama misteri yang menjanjikan rahasia hidup dan mati kepada para peserta inisiasi, yang disumpah merahasiakannya.
statement.en: Like the Eleusinian Mysteries, the cult of Isis grew into a mystery religion promising the secrets of life and death to initiates, who were sworn to secrecy.

quote: Her temple on the island of Philae in Upper Egypt would remain an active pilgrimage site for thousands of years until closed in the 6th century CE by the Christian emperor Justinian.

statement.id: Kuil Isis di pulau Philae di Mesir Hulu tetap menjadi tempat ziarah selama ribuan tahun hingga ditutup pada abad ke-6 M oleh kaisar Kristen Justinian.
statement.en: Her temple on the island of Philae in Upper Egypt remained an active pilgrimage site for thousands of years until closed in the 6th century CE by the Christian emperor Justinian.

quote: Eventually, she became associated with the sea and was a protectress of sailors and merchants who wore talismans honoring her and invoked her aid in times of trouble (attested to by archaeological evidence).

statement.id: Isis akhirnya dikaitkan dengan laut dan menjadi pelindung pelaut dan pedagang yang memakai jimat untuknya dan memohon bantuannya saat bahaya.
statement.en: Isis eventually became associated with the sea and was protectress of sailors and merchants who wore talismans honoring her and invoked her aid in times of trouble.

quote: Unlike the other gods of Egypt, Isis transcended national borders and was worshiped by the Greeks and the Romans who believed in her as the supreme deity who created the world.

statement.id: Berbeda dari dewa Mesir lainnya, Isis melampaui batas negara dan dipuja orang Yunani dan Romawi yang meyakininya sebagai dewa tertinggi pencipta dunia.
statement.en: Unlike other Egyptian gods, Isis transcended national borders and was worshiped by Greeks and Romans, who believed in her as the supreme deity who created the world.

quote: Set was jealous of his brother's power and prestige, however, and so conceived a plan to get rid of him. He had a beautiful coffin made to Osiris' exact height

statement.id: Set iri pada kekuasaan dan gengsi saudaranya dan merencanakan menyingkirkannya, dengan membuat peti mati indah seukuran tinggi Osiris.
statement.en: Set was jealous of his brother's power and prestige and plotted to get rid of him, having a beautiful coffin made to Osiris's exact height.

quote: Isis was distraught when she found her husband was missing and went searching for him all through Egypt without success.

statement.id: Isis sangat bersedih ketika suaminya hilang dan mencarinya ke seluruh Mesir tanpa hasil.
statement.en: Isis was distraught when her husband went missing and searched all through Egypt without success.

quote: After leaving the court, Isis cut Osiris from the tree and carried his body back to Egypt where she hid him from Set in the swampy region of the Nile Delta.

statement.id: Isis mengeluarkan Osiris dari pohon dan membawa jasadnya kembali ke Mesir, menyembunyikannya dari Set di rawa-rawa Delta Nil.
statement.en: Isis cut Osiris from the tree and carried his body back to Egypt, hiding him from Set in the swampy region of the Nile Delta.

quote: Isis still was able to revive Osiris and, once he was alive, she assumed the form of a kite and flew around him, drew the seed from his body into her own, and became pregnant with a son, Horus

statement.id: Isis berhasil menghidupkan kembali Osiris, mengambil wujud kite (sejenis elang), terbang mengelilinginya, dan mengandung putra, Horus.
statement.en: Isis was still able to revive Osiris and, in the form of a kite, flew around him and became pregnant with a son, Horus.

quote: Even though Osiris now lived, he was incomplete and could no longer rule the land of the living. He withdrew into the afterlife where he became Lord and Judge of the Dead.

statement.id: Meski hidup lagi, Osiris tidak lengkap dan tak bisa lagi memerintah dunia orang hidup; ia mundur ke alam baka dan menjadi Penguasa dan Hakim Orang Mati.
statement.en: Though alive again, Osiris was incomplete and could no longer rule the living; he withdrew into the afterlife where he became Lord and Judge of the Dead.

quote: Isis, fearing what Set might do to her son, hid Horus among the swamps of Egypt until he was grown. At that point, Horus emerged as a mighty warrior and battled Set for control of the world.

statement.id: Karena takut akan perbuatan Set, Isis menyembunyikan Horus di rawa-rawa Mesir sampai dewasa; Horus lalu muncul sebagai prajurit perkasa dan melawan Set demi menguasai dunia.
statement.en: Fearing what Set might do, Isis hid Horus in the swamps of Egypt until he was grown; Horus then emerged as a mighty warrior and battled Set for control of the world.

quote: Isis took the child in her arms and called each of the scorpions by their secret name, thereby dominating them and neutralizing their power, and recited spells of great magic. The poison evaporated, leaving the child's body, and he revived.

statement.id: Dalam kisah Isis dan Tujuh Kalajengking, Isis memanggil tiap kalajengking dengan nama rahasianya sehingga menundukkan mereka, melafalkan mantra sihir agung, dan racun lenyap dari tubuh anak itu sehingga ia sadar kembali.
statement.en: In the story of Isis and the Seven Scorpions, Isis called each scorpion by its secret name, dominating them, and recited spells of great magic; the poison left the child's body and he revived.

quote: The story relates how, when Horus was an infant and Isis was hiding him in the swamp lands from Set, seven scorpions kept her company. She would sometimes go out in the evenings for food, and the scorpions would form a kind of bodyguard around her.

statement.id: Ketika Horus masih bayi dan Isis menyembunyikannya di rawa dari Set, tujuh kalajengking menemaninya dan membentuk semacam pengawal di sekelilingnya saat ia keluar mencari makan pada malam hari.
statement.en: When Horus was an infant and Isis was hiding him in the swamp from Set, seven scorpions kept her company and formed a kind of bodyguard around her when she went out for food in the evenings.

quote: When Alexander the Great (l. 356-323 BCE) conquered Egypt in 331 BCE his troops associated Isis with the popular Greek goddess Demeter.

statement.id: Ketika Aleksander Agung menaklukkan Mesir pada 331 SM, pasukannya mengaitkan Isis dengan dewi Yunani Demeter.
statement.en: When Alexander the Great conquered Egypt in 331 BCE his troops associated Isis with the Greek goddess Demeter.

quote: under the reign of Caligula (r. 37-41 CE) the worship of Isis in Rome was firmly established by the emperor through the Isiac Festival in her honor.

statement.id: Pada masa Caligula (37-41 M) pemujaan Isis di Roma dikukuhkan oleh kaisar lewat Festival Isiak.
statement.en: Under Caligula (37-41 CE) the worship of Isis in Rome was firmly established by the emperor through the Isiac Festival in her honor.

quote: A temple of Isis has been found in Pompeii, and another in Great Britain at the Roman site of Londinium (modern London).

statement.id: Kuil Isis ditemukan di Pompeii dan di situs Romawi Londinium (London modern) di Britania Raya.
statement.en: A temple of Isis has been found in Pompeii, and another at the Roman site of Londinium (modern London) in Great Britain.

quote: Her cult in Rome was the greatest rival to the young religion of Christianity, which drew upon the image of Isis and the child-god Horus for the depiction of the Madonna with the Christ child.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, kultus Isis di Roma adalah saingan terbesar agama Kristen yang masih muda, yang meminjam citra Isis dan Horus kecil untuk penggambaran Madonna dengan bayi Kristus.
statement.en: According to World History Encyclopedia, her cult in Rome was the greatest rival of the young Christian religion, which drew on the image of Isis and the child-god Horus for the Madonna with the Christ child.

quote: Philae continued as a vital site dedicated to Isis until the emperor Justinian closed it, along with other important centers of learning and worship in 529 CE.

statement.id: Philae tetap menjadi situs penting bagi Isis hingga kaisar Justinian menutupnya pada 529 M.
statement.en: Philae continued as a vital site dedicated to Isis until the emperor Justinian closed it in 529 CE.

quote: Nephthys was never depicted as evil to Isis' good but was associated with death while Isis with life and so these two sister-deities symbolized cosmic balance.

statement.id: Nephthys tidak pernah digambarkan jahat bagi Isis yang baik, melainkan dikaitkan dengan kematian sedangkan Isis dengan kehidupan, sehingga kedua dewi bersaudari itu melambangkan keseimbangan kosmis.
statement.en: Nephthys was never depicted as evil to Isis's good but was associated with death while Isis was associated with life, so the two sister-deities symbolized cosmic balance.

quote: She and her husband and son replaced the Theban Triad of Amon, Mut, and Khons, who had been the most popular trinity of gods in Egypt.

statement.id: Isis bersama suami dan putranya menggantikan Triad Thebes (Amon, Mut, dan Khons), trinitas dewa yang paling populer di Mesir.
statement.en: Isis, her husband, and her son replaced the Theban Triad of Amon, Mut, and Khons, the most popular trinity of gods in Egypt.

quote: As the goddess who brought the yearly inundation of the Nile which fertilized the land she was Sati, for example, and as the goddess who created and preserved life she was Ankhet, and so on.

statement.id: Sebagai dewi pembawa banjir tahunan Sungai Nil yang menyuburkan tanah ia disebut Sati, dan sebagai dewi yang menciptakan dan memelihara kehidupan ia disebut Ankhet.
statement.en: As the goddess who brought the yearly Nile inundation that fertilized the land she was Sati, and as the goddess who created and preserved life she was Ankhet.

quote: She is regularly portrayed as the selfless, giving, mother, wife, and protectress, who places other's interests and well-being ahead of her own.

statement.id: Isis biasanya digambarkan sebagai ibu, istri, dan pelindung yang tanpa pamrih, murah hati, dan mengutamakan kepentingan orang lain.
statement.en: Isis is regularly portrayed as a selfless, giving mother, wife, and protectress who puts others' interests and well-being ahead of her own.

quote: Nut, however, was already pregnant by Geb and soon gave birth to five children: Osiris, Isis, Set, Nephthys, and Horus (known as Horus the Elder).

statement.id: Nut melahirkan lima anak dari Geb: Osiris, Isis, Set, Nephthys, dan Horus (Horus yang Tua).
statement.en: Nut gave birth to five children by Geb: Osiris, Isis, Set, Nephthys, and Horus (known as Horus the Elder).

quote: Osiris married Isis and, as the first born, assumed rule as Lord of the Earth, with Isis as his queen and consort.

statement.id: Osiris menikahi Isis dan, sebagai anak sulung, memerintah sebagai Penguasa Bumi dengan Isis sebagai ratu dan pendampingnya.
statement.en: Osiris married Isis and, as the firstborn, ruled as Lord of the Earth with Isis as his queen and consort.

quote: I am she that is the naturall mother of all things, mistresse and governesse of all the Elements, the initiall progeny of worlds, chiefe of powers divine, Queene of heaven!
locator: Book 11, the goddess speaks to Lucius

statement.id: Dalam terjemahan Adlington atas karya Apuleius, sang dewi menyebut dirinya ibu alami segala sesuatu, penguasa semua unsur, keturunan awal dunia, pemimpin kuasa ilahi, dan Ratu Langit.
statement.en: In Adlington's translation of Apuleius, the goddess calls herself the natural mother of all things, mistress of all the elements, the initial progeny of worlds, chief of divine powers, and Queen of heaven.

quote: at my will the planets of the ayre, the wholesome winds of the Seas, and the silences of hell be diposed
locator: Book 11, the goddess speaks to Lucius

statement.id: Sang dewi dalam karya Apuleius menyatakan bahwa atas kehendaknya planet-planet langit, angin laut yang menyehatkan, dan kesunyian neraka diatur.
statement.en: In Apuleius's work the goddess declares that at her will the planets of the air, the wholesome winds of the seas, and the silences of hell are disposed.

quote: for the Phrygians call me the mother of the Gods: the Athenians, Minerva: the Cyprians, Venus: the Candians, Diana: the Sicilians Proserpina: the Eleusians, Ceres: some Juno, other Bellona, other Hecate
locator: Book 11, the goddess speaks to Lucius

statement.id: Dalam karya Apuleius sang dewi menyebut bahwa ia dipuja dengan banyak nama: bangsa Frigia menyebutnya ibu para dewa, orang Athena Minerva, orang Siprus Venus, dan seterusnya.
statement.en: In Apuleius's work the goddess says she is worshipped under many names: the Phrygians call her mother of the Gods, the Athenians Minerva, the Cyprians Venus, and so on.

quote: and the Aegyptians which are excellent in all kind of ancient doctrine, and by their proper ceremonies accustome to worship mee, doe call mee Queene Isis.
locator: Book 11, the goddess speaks to Lucius

statement.id: Dalam karya Apuleius, orang Mesir, yang unggul dalam segala ajaran kuno dan memujanya dengan upacara mereka sendiri, menyebutnya Ratu Isis.
statement.en: In Apuleius's work the Egyptians, excellent in all ancient doctrine and worshipping her with their own ceremonies, call her Queen Isis.

quote: In her right hand shee had a timbrell of brasse, which gave a pleasant sound, in her left hand shee bare a cup of gold, out of the mouth whereof the serpent Aspis lifted up his head
locator: Book 11, the vision of the goddess

statement.id: Dalam penglihatan di karya Apuleius, sang dewi memegang rebana kuningan di tangan kanan dan cawan emas di tangan kiri, dengan ular aspis mengangkat kepala dari mulut cawan.
statement.en: In the vision in Apuleius's work, the goddess holds a brass timbrel in her right hand and a golden cup in her left, from whose mouth a serpent, the asp, lifts its head.

quote: Isis was a major goddess in ancient Egyptian religion whose worship spread throughout the Greco-Roman world.

statement.id: Isis adalah dewi utama dalam agama Mesir kuno yang pemujaannya menyebar ke seluruh dunia Yunani-Romawi.
statement.en: Isis was a major goddess in ancient Egyptian religion whose worship spread throughout the Greco-Roman world.

quote: Her reputed magical power was greater than that of all other gods, and she was said to govern the natural world and wield power over fate itself.

statement.id: Kekuatan sihirnya konon lebih besar daripada semua dewa lain, dan ia dikatakan mengatur alam dan berkuasa atas takdir.
statement.en: Her reputed magical power was greater than that of all other gods, and she was said to govern the natural world and wield power over fate itself.

quote: In one spell, Isis creates a snake that bites Ra, who is older and greater than she is, and makes him ill with its venom. She offers to cure Ra if he will tell her his true, secret name

statement.id: Dalam salah satu mantra, Isis menciptakan ular yang menggigit Ra dan membuatnya sakit dengan bisanya, lalu menawarkan menyembuhkannya jika Ra mau menyebut nama rahasianya yang sejati.
statement.en: In one spell Isis creates a snake that bites Ra and makes him ill with its venom, then offers to cure him if he tells her his true, secret name.

quote: In later texts, she uses her powers of transformation to fight and destroy Set and his followers.

statement.id: Dalam teks-teks kemudian, Isis memakai kekuatan perubahan wujudnya untuk melawan dan menghancurkan Set dan para pengikutnya.
statement.en: In later texts Isis uses her powers of transformation to fight and destroy Set and his followers.

quote: She was believed to help the dead enter the afterlife as she had helped Osiris, and she was considered the divine mother of the pharaoh, who was likened to Horus. Her maternal aid was invoked in healing spells to benefit ordinary people.

statement.id: Isis dipercaya membantu orang mati memasuki alam baka seperti ia menolong Osiris, dianggap ibu ilahi firaun, dan bantuannya dipanggil dalam mantra penyembuhan bagi orang biasa.
statement.en: Isis was believed to help the dead enter the afterlife as she had helped Osiris, was considered the divine mother of the pharaoh, and her maternal aid was invoked in healing spells for ordinary people.

quote: neither Isis nor her husband Osiris were mentioned by name before the Fifth Dynasty (c. 2494-2345 BCE).

statement.id: Baik Isis maupun suaminya Osiris tidak disebut namanya sebelum Dinasti Kelima (sekitar 2494-2345 SM).
statement.en: Neither Isis nor her husband Osiris were mentioned by name before the Fifth Dynasty (c. 2494-2345 BCE).

quote: During the New Kingdom (c. 1550 - c. 1070 BCE), Isis took on traits that originally belonged to Hathor, the preeminent goddess of earlier time.

statement.id: Pada Kerajaan Baru (sekitar 1550-1070 SM), Isis mengambil sifat yang semula milik Hathor, dewi terkemuka masa sebelumnya.
statement.en: During the New Kingdom (c. 1550-1070 BCE) Isis took on traits that originally belonged to Hathor, the preeminent goddess of an earlier time.

quote: Her Egyptian name was written as 𓊨𓏏𓐰𓆇𓁐 (ꜣst)

statement.id: Nama Mesir Isis ditulis 𓊨𓏏𓐰𓆇𓁐 (ꜣst).
statement.en: Isis's Egyptian name was written 𓊨𓏏𓐰𓆇𓁐 (ꜣst).

quote: Therefore, the Egyptologist Kurt Sethe suggested she was originally a personification of thrones.

statement.id: Egiptolog Kurt Sethe mengusulkan bahwa Isis semula adalah personifikasi takhta.
statement.en: The Egyptologist Kurt Sethe suggested she was originally a personification of thrones.

quote: Other scholars, such as Jürgen Osing and Klaus P. Kuhlmann, have disputed this interpretation, because of dissimilarities between Isis's name and the word for a throne or a lack of evidence that the throne was ever deified.

statement.id: Sarjana lain, seperti Jürgen Osing dan Klaus P. Kuhlmann, menolak tafsir itu karena perbedaan antara nama Isis dan kata untuk takhta, atau kurangnya bukti bahwa takhta pernah diilahikan.
statement.en: Other scholars, such as Jürgen Osing and Klaus P. Kuhlmann, dispute this interpretation because of dissimilarities between Isis's name and the word for a throne, or a lack of evidence that the throne was ever deified.

quote: Isis continues to appear in Western culture, particularly in esotericism and modern paganism, often as a personification of nature or the feminine aspect of divinity.

statement.id: Isis terus muncul dalam budaya Barat, khususnya dalam esoterisme dan paganisme modern, sering sebagai personifikasi alam atau sisi feminin keilahian.
statement.en: Isis continues to appear in Western culture, particularly in esotericism and modern paganism, often as a personification of nature or the feminine aspect of divinity.

quote: Isis's Greek devotees ascribed to her traits taken from Greek deities, such as the invention of marriage and the protection of ships at sea.

statement.id: Para pemuja Yunani Isis mengaitkan dengannya sifat dari dewa Yunani, seperti penemuan pernikahan dan perlindungan kapal di laut.
statement.en: Isis's Greek devotees ascribed to her traits taken from Greek deities, such as the invention of marriage and the protection of ships at sea.

quote: Her worship may have influenced Christian beliefs and practices such as the veneration of Mary, but the evidence for this influence is ambiguous and often controversial.

statement.id: Menurut Wikipedia, pemujaan Isis mungkin memengaruhi kepercayaan dan praktik Kristen seperti penghormatan kepada Maria, tetapi bukti pengaruh itu tidak jelas dan sering diperdebatkan.
statement.en: According to Wikipedia, her worship may have influenced Christian beliefs and practices such as the veneration of Mary, but the evidence for this influence is ambiguous and often controversial.

quote: Isis became the goddess of all the people of Egypt, male and female, royal and common, alike.

statement.id: Isis menjadi dewi seluruh rakyat Mesir, laki-laki dan perempuan, bangsawan dan rakyat biasa.
statement.en: Isis became the goddess of all the people of Egypt, male and female, royal and common alike.
